cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back everyone, it's time to test your new skills with a project.
cues.zh: 講師：各位，歡迎回來，該透過專案測試新技能了。

cues.en: So you're going to be building a model that will attempt to predict whether or not someone will pay back their loan based off historical information.
cues.zh: 你要建立模型，根據歷史資訊，預測某個人是否會償還貸款。

cues.en: You have three options for this project.
Either go completely solo, an exercise guide notebook, or code along with the solution lectures.
cues.zh: 完全自己做、跟著練習引導筆記本，或跟著解答影片一起寫。

cues.en: Let's quickly review your three options.
cues.zh: 快速看一下這三種選項。

cues.en: Your first option is to simply read the introduction in the exercise notebook, and then proceed with your own methods to build a predictive model.
cues.zh: 第一種是直接閱讀練習筆記本的介紹，再用自己的方法建立預測模型。

cues.en: You may even be able to build a predictive model that actually outperforms our guided solution.
cues.zh: 你甚至可能建立出比我們引導解答表現更好的模型。

cues.en: So feel free that if you feel very confident with the material that we've already presented for you, to just take your own stab at the project and see what you can come up with.
cues.zh: 如果對已經介紹的內容很有信心，可以自己挑戰這個專案，看看能做出什麼成果。

cues.en: The second option is to follow along with the exercise guide notebook.
cues.zh: 第二種是跟著練習引導筆記本。

cues.en: So we've written out a notebook with step-by-step tasks for you to complete in order to guide you through building a predictive model.
cues.zh: 我們寫好了逐步任務，帶領你完成預測模型的建立。

cues.en: And then finally, the third option is to simply code along with the solutions lecture.
cues.zh: 最後，第三種是直接跟著解答課程寫程式。

cues.en: So you can skip the next overview lecture and simply treat this project as a large code along project, so you can code along with us as we guide you through our solution video for the project.
cues.zh: 可以跳過下一堂總覽，把它當成大型實作專案，跟著專案解答影片一起寫。

cues.en: Feel free to choose any of these three options, depending on how comfortable you felt with the previous material we've gone over.
cues.zh: 請依照自己對先前內容的熟悉程度，任選一種。

cues.en: Keep in mind, this is a very large project, and to reflect a realistic situation, we actually spend a lot of time performing feature engineering and preparing and analyzing our data for our model.
cues.zh: 請記得，這個專案很大；為了反映真實情境，我們會花很多時間做特徵工程，以及準備、分析模型所用的資料。

cues.en: So let's explore the project guide notebook in the next lecture, I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 下一堂就來探索專案引導筆記本，到時見。
